items.title: Wall Street’s Newest Teradyne Bull Just Sent a $2 Billion Signal That the Stock’s 56% Crash Went Too Far
items.summary: Teradyne jumped 8.3% to $265.78 on Wednesday after Jefferies started coverage at buy with a $284 target, calling it a compute test company with a possible $2 billion Nvidia revenue stream by 2029. The stock had lost 56% from its June 30 record to its November 5 close. Here is what history says after the stock's past 8% jumps, computed since 2010 and for this year, and what the day did to a retiree who bought 1,000 shares at $20.34 in 2016, with the tax on selling all, half or 480 of them.
